query: WITH next AS ( INSERT INTO event_outbox_aggregate_seq (consumer, aggregate_key, seq) SELECT $8, $10::text, 1 WHERE $10::text <> '' ON CONFLICT (consumer, aggregate_key) DO UPDATE SET seq = event_outbox_aggregate_seq.seq + 1 RETURNING seq) INSERT INTO event_outbox (id, channel, user_id, payload, actor_kind, actor_id, origin_instance_id, consumer, fact, deliver_to_origin, aggregate_key, aggregate_seq) SELECT $1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,TRUE,$10::text, COALESCE((SELECT seq FROM next), 0)
